records.jp: 起立！
records.en_original: All rise!
records.en: All rise!

records.jp: 礼！　ちゃくせーき！
records.en_original: Bow! Be seated!
records.en: Bow! Be seated!

records.jp: え？　三人とも、何してるの？
records.en_original: What are the three of you doing?
records.en: What are the three of you doing?

records.jp: あ、いいところに来たね。<CR>愛央も一緒にどう？　勉強会
records.en_original: Oh, just in time. We're having a study session. Wanna join us, Ao?
records.en: Oh, just in time. We're having a study session. Wanna join us, Ao?

records.jp: 勉強会……？
records.en_original: A study session?
records.en: A study session?

records.jp: はい。こんなときに<CR>心配することじゃないかもしれないんですけど……
records.en_original: Yes. It may not be our top priority at the moment, but...
records.en: Yes. It may not be our top priority at the moment, but...

records.jp: わたしたち、勉強しなくていいんでしょうか？<CR>そう思ったら、不安になってしまって
records.en_original: I suddenly got very worried about the fact that we haven't been studying.
records.en: I suddenly got very worried about the fact that we haven't been studying.

records.jp: それで、お勉強が得意な日菜子ちゃんと一緒に<CR>勉強会しよってことになったんだよね！
records.en_original: So we decided to form a study group with Hinako 'cause she's so smart!
records.en: So we decided to form a study group with Hinako 'cause she's so smart!

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ
records.en_original: Oh, I see.
records.en: Oh, I see.

records.jp: （事情は分かったけど、なんでわざわざ<CR>号令をかけてるんだろ……）
records.en_original: (I get what they're doing, but why did they bother with the whole morning routine?)
records.en: (I get what they're doing, but why did they bother with the whole morning routine?)

records.jp: えっとね、私は苦手な数学を頑張るつもり！
records.en_original: So, I want to focus on my worst subject, math.
records.en: So, I want to focus on my worst subject, math.

records.jp: わたしは、国語にしようかなと思ってます
records.en_original: I'd like to study Japanese literature.
records.en: I'd like to study Japanese literature.

records.jp: 私は英語かな。<CR>愛央は、どの教科にする？
records.en_original: English for me. What do you want to study, Ao?
records.en: English for me. What do you want to study, Ao?

records.jp: って、いつの間にか参加が決定してるし！<CR>ええっと、私は……
records.en_original: Wait, how did I get dragged into this?! Well, I guess I'll study...
records.en: Wait, how did I get dragged into this?! Well, I guess I'll study...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと数学！
records.en_original: Math with Hiori!
records.en: Math with Hiori!

records.jp: やった！　愛央ちゃん、一緒に頑張ろうね
records.en_original: Yay! Let's do our best, Ao!
records.en: Yay! Let's do our best, Ao!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: こ、このα×βは５だから、<CR>こっちの式に代入して……
records.en_original: Umm, a times b is 5, so if we plug that into this formula...
records.en: Umm, a times b is 5, so if we plug that into this formula...

records.jp: えっ、５なの？　２じゃなくて？
records.en_original: Wait, 5? Isn't it 2?
records.en: Wait, 5? Isn't it 2?

records.jp: ええっ！？　えーっと、んーっと……<CR>うがぁ～～っ！　分かんなくなってきたぁ！
records.en_original: What?! Ummm, uh... Aaagh! I'm so lost!
records.en: What?! Ummm, uh... Aaagh! I'm so lost!

records.jp: 大丈夫、大丈夫！<CR>私も分かんないから！
records.en_original: It's okay, it's okay! I don't get it at all either!
records.en: It's okay, it's okay! I don't get it at all either!

records.jp: ううっ、愛央ちゃぁん！
records.en_original: Waaah, Ao! I'm glad someone understands...
records.en: Waaah, Ao! I'm glad someone understands...

records.jp: こら、そんなことで友情を確かめ合わないの。<CR>教えてあげるから、こっちおいでよ
records.en_original: This is what brings you two together? Here, let me show you how to work the problem.
records.en: This is what brings you two together? Here, let me show you how to work the problem.

records.jp: 詩帆さんと国語の勉強がしたい！
records.en_original: I'd like to work on Japanese literature with Shiho!
records.en: I'd like to work on Japanese literature with Shiho!

records.jp: いいですよ。でも、教科書が一つしかないから<CR>一緒に見ることになりますけど……いいですか？
records.en_original: That would be nice. I only have one book, though. Do you mind sharing?
records.en: That would be nice. I only have one book, though. Do you mind sharing?

records.jp: もっちろん！　よろしくお願いしまーす！
records.en_original: Not at all! Thanks for letting me join you!
records.en: Not at all! Thanks for letting me join you!

records.jp: 詩帆さんって、国語得意なんだね。<CR>どうしたら、そんなにできるようになるの？
records.en_original: Wow, Shiho. How did you get so good at this?
records.en: Wow, Shiho. How did you get so good at this?

records.jp: 特別なことはしてないんですけど……<CR>強いて言うなら、読書が趣味だからかもしれません
records.en_original: I don't really do anything special... I suppose the fact that I love to read helps.
records.en: I don't really do anything special... I suppose the fact that I love to read helps.

records.jp: コーヒーをゆっくり飲みながら、<CR>ページをめくるのが好きなんです
records.en_original: I just love turning the pages of a book while sipping on a cup of coffee.
records.en: I just love turning the pages of a book while sipping on a cup of coffee.

records.jp: わあ……<CR>なんだか大人な時間の使い方だね
records.en_original: Wow... That's such a grown-up way of spending time.
records.en: Wow... That's such a grown-up way of spending time.

records.jp: 気になるなら、<CR>星崎さんも、今度ご一緒しませんか？
records.en_original: Would you like to join me sometime?
records.en: Would you like to join me sometime?

records.jp: ……コーヒーに、<CR>詩帆さんの手作りお菓子もつけてくれる？
records.en_original: ...Can I have some of your handmade sweets to go with the coffee?
records.en: ...Can I have some of your handmade sweets to go with the coffee?

records.jp: ふふ、特別ですよ？
records.en_original: Hehe. Sure.
records.en: Hehe. Sure.

records.jp: 日菜子さんと英語の勉強をしようかな！
records.en_original: I think I wanna study English with Hinako!
records.en: I think I wanna study English with Hinako!

records.jp: 分かった。<CR>ビシバシ教えてあげるね！
records.en_original: All right, I'll teach you everything I know!
records.en: All right, I'll teach you everything I know!

records.jp: お、お手柔らかにお願いします……
records.en_original: P-please be gentle...
records.en: P-please be gentle...

records.jp: えっ、えっ！？　すごい！<CR>日菜子さん、発音めっちゃ綺麗だね！
records.en_original: Whoa, Hinako! Your pronunciation's perfect!
records.en: Whoa, Hinako! Your pronunciation's perfect!

records.jp: バレエの関係で、海外に行くこともあったから
records.en_original: Well, I had to travel abroad for ballet sometimes.
records.en: Well, I had to travel abroad for ballet sometimes.

records.jp: 海外の先生も多いし、英語は話せて<CR>損はなかったんだ
records.en_original: And a lot of ballet instructors are from overseas, so I figured it would be useful to speak English.
records.en: And a lot of ballet instructors are from overseas, so I figured it would be useful to speak English.

records.jp: えーっ、すごい！！<CR>ほんと……すっごくすごいよ！
records.en_original: Really?! That's so cool! Seriously!
records.en: Really?! That's so cool! Seriously!

records.jp: そんなに感動されると、なんか恥ずかしいかも。<CR>……ほら、愛央も発音練習してみたら？
records.en_original: Aww, you're making me blush. Come on, let's practice together!
records.en: Aww, you're making me blush. Come on, let's practice together!

records.jp: うーん、日菜子さんの後だと<CR>なんか気が引けるっていうか……
records.en_original: I...I feel embarrassed practicing in front of you...
records.en: I...I feel embarrassed practicing in front of you...

records.jp: 最初は下手で当然だよ。責任もって、<CR>できるようになるまで教えてあげるから。ね？
records.en_original: It's natural to be bad at something at first. I'll help you practice until you can do it. Promise.
records.en: It's natural to be bad at something at first. I'll help you practice until you can do it. Promise.

records.jp: ……よし、そろそろ休憩しようか
records.en_original: All right, how about we take a break?
records.en: All right, how about we take a break?

records.jp: はあ～、疲れたぁ
records.en_original: Phew, I'm exhausted.
records.en: Phew, I'm exhausted.

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃんがいなかったら<CR>もっと早くリタイアしてたかも～！
records.en_original: I would've quit way earlier had it not been for Hinako!
records.en: I would've quit way earlier had it not been for Hinako!

records.jp: 日菜子？
records.en_original: Hinako?
records.en: Hinako?

records.jp: いや……こういうの、悪くないなあって
records.en_original: Oh, I just... I really like this.
records.en: Oh, I just... I really like this.

records.jp: 私、バレエを辞めてから<CR>勉強くらいしかすることがなかったから……
records.en_original: Studying was pretty much all I had to do after I quit ballet.
records.en: Studying was pretty much all I had to do after I quit ballet.

records.jp: 勉強は得意だけど、<CR>好きでもなかったんだよね
records.en_original: You could say that I'm studious, but to be honest, I don't particularly enjoy it.
records.en: You could say that I'm studious, but to be honest, I don't particularly enjoy it.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: でもさ。そのおかげで<CR>今こうやって、みんなに勉強を教えられる
records.en_original: But if hadn't done all that, I wouldn't have had the chance to teach you guys in this study group.
records.en: But if hadn't done all that, I wouldn't have had the chance to teach you guys in this study group.

records.jp: そう思えば、バレエを辞めたからって<CR>何もかも投げ出さなくてよかったよ
records.en_original: It makes me feel that I was right to not quit everything else along with ballet.
records.en: It makes me feel that I was right to not quit everything else along with ballet.

records.jp: 私が知らなかっただけで、この世には<CR>無駄なことなんて何もないのかも……なんてね！
records.en_original: I never realized it before, but there isn't a single thing in this world that happens without a purpose. W-well, at least, I don't think so...
records.en: I never realized it before, but there isn't a single thing in this world that happens without a purpose. W-well, at least, I don't think so...
